name: suspender one arm biceps curl
description: You curl yourself up with one arm holding a single strap, a tough unilateral biceps move.
instructions: Hold one handle palm up and lean back at an angle.
Keep your feet planted and body straight.
Bend the elbow and pull your body toward your hand.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
